signals.label: Depth durability
signals.finding: Quotes are short-lived but in line with this venue: the median resting order expires in 22s and nothing displayed is past expiry. 990 shares across 6 orders, all of it owned by one address (proxy delegating to 0xB35e383c23987A05fce1Bf851Bfa70ABd5bA9BB8, so the code deciding whether it can cancel is replaceable by whoever controls the target). 100% is withdrawable at will, none of it committed.
signals.basis: Per-order `owner` and `expireTimestampNs` from getAllOpenOrdersOffChain: fields every aggregated view sums away. Measured on all 10 live markets, twice: 1 owner holding 100% of both sides, 6 orders, TTL 11-28s, 0 shares past expiry. So a ~20s quote and a sole owner are this venue's normal and cannot be the alarm; phantom depth and a sub-8s TTL are the deviations.
